closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, carb quality, and easy to fit into familiar meals, but the biggest weaknesses are low magnesium, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals, blood and oxygen support, and bone health because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side, and calcium gives the bone-health case something to work with.
